notes:
Discovery notes (concise):
- Team: 8 engs on editor runtime, 3 infra. CTO (R. Alvarez) very hands-on.
- Primary ask: VS Code extension copilots with real-time streaming completions + inline suggestions (cursor-aware), sub-50ms token latency target for median on user-facing flows.
- Need model/version pinning per-release channel (stable/beta/internal). Must support pinned quantized variants for offline/low-cost fallback.
- Auth & rate limits: per-org API key + per-seat throttles; want per-user token quotas and burst rules. Concerned about graceful 429 handling in-editor.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance, KMS integration for encryption, and audit logs for prompt/response retention.
- Cost sensitivity: heavy read-heavy traffic during coding sessions — want Optimize recommendations for batching & cache to reduce tokens.
- Quote from CTO: "If median token RTT > 60ms devs will reject — latency is everything for inline suggestions."
- Competitor checks: evaluated GitHub Copilot and Tabnine; need better offline fallback and cheaper per-token economics.
- Internal ask: include per-token cost breakdown in POC dashboard and support streaming + function-calling later.
- Legal: DPA requested; security questionnaire in progress (see SEC-1128).
